digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET backstop
propositions: Bugs with explicit 'review-plan' currently run only the light advisory tier (DET + necessity probe) with det_blocking=[] downgrade, allowing complex fixes with substantive design changes to merge without full rubric review.

The bug tier routing seam (orchestrator.route_criteria) must escalate to the full blocking rubric when the ticket's persisted file_impact enumerates any non-test path, covering both precheck and batch-runner callers via a shared deterministic helper, with no CLI flag or schema changes.

Gerrit DET criterion must block oversized bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) lacking a current-or-code-drifted attestation by reading the plan-review attestation cross-host via opcert verification with the trusted-environment machinery, never via own-env plan_review_status.

The verdict predicate must accept certified/stale-code/stale-head attestations, flag deterministic attestation failures (stale, unsigned, mismatch, invalid era), and fail open (advisory only) on infrastructure unavailability or unknown verdicts.
Non-test line classification excludes tests/** and conftest.py; the 150-line threshold is a single shared constant imported by both the review-bot criterion and backtest.

The backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must achieve exact set equality: flagged commits == the 13 hand-adjudicated substantive fixes, with zero mechanical false positives among the remaining 100 commits.
